outcome.description: recorded means all proposals were assessed and useful amendments are pushed; already_documented means existing guidance covers all useful proposals; not_worth_recording means none adds worthwhile guidance; blocked means assessment or delivery could not be completed. Explain exclusions in reason.

learning.description: The selected reusable lesson and its conditions, or empty when none qualifies. Do not invent a lesson to fill this field.

evidence.description: Source references supporting the lesson. For already_documented, include the guidance location.

destination_pr_url.description: First documentation PR URL, retained for compatibility; empty if none exists. Use destination_pr_urls for the full set.

files_changed.description: Guidance paths changed by this assignment.

reason.description: What was recorded, covered, or excluded and why; for blocked, the failed step and what is needed. Justify new sections with search terms and nearest existing guidance.

destination_pr_urls.description: All documentation PR URLs for this ticket writeback, across repositories; empty when none exist.
